headline: 92% of iteration time is dispatch overhead
next_action: Fix granularity before any inner-loop tuning: fuse or batch stages, or move to a runtime with a cheaper submit path. Micro-optimising a kernel that occupies a few percent of the iteration cannot pay off.

rows.headline: 92% of iteration time is dispatch overhead
rows.detail: 116 dispatches x 385 us = 44.7 ms of 48.4 ms per iteration (92%).
rows.fix: Fix granularity before any inner-loop tuning: fuse or batch stages, or move to a runtime with a cheaper submit path. Micro-optimising a kernel that occupies a few percent of the iteration cannot pay off.

rows.headline: dispatch count matches the source platform
rows.detail: 116 here vs 116 on the source platform (1.00x).

rows.headline: 1 proposed fusion(s) need a cross-workgroup barrier
rows.fix: silu->down: keep the dispatch boundary, or use a backend with a device-wide barrier. No workgroup size makes this legal, and a shader that reads the whole producer output without one reads garbage.

rows.headline: workgroup size within the verified ceiling
0.03% of peak: the bottleneck is not arithmetic
rows.fix: This is a dispatch, synchronisation or copy-bound shape. Measure per-dispatch cost and dispatch count before touching the kernel.

rows.headline: 37% below the source platform
rows.detail: 20.65 here vs 33 on the source platform (0.63x).
rows.fix: Attribute the gap before changing kernels. A uniform slowdown across every kernel is a per-dispatch or per-copy cost; a single slow kernel is a kernel.

rows.headline: 1 extension(s) available but not enabled
rows.detail: VK_KHR_timeline_semaphore: advertised=True enabled=False used=False. Not enabled: VK_KHR_timeline_semaphore.
rows.fix: Enable it in the create-info first; an advertised feature is not a usable one.
